title: Animation preset
description: Data contract of one animation preset (PRD §5.6). Static data only: the frame function lives in renderer/remotion/animations, keyed by id. No functions, no pixels, no CSS.

shortScene.description: What a scene shorter than minFrames shows. static: the end state from its first frame.

reducedMotion.description: What the preset draws when reduced motion is requested (task 023). static: the end state from its first frame.
